title: 真实同义词索引重开失败：恢复严格规则并验证多词、停用词和历史查询
answer:
```python
import os,pathlib
def repair(request,index,rules_path,approved_rules):
    path=pathlib.Path(rules_path);temporary=path.with_name(path.name+'.approved-next')
    temporary.write_text('\n'.join(approved_rules)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
    os.replace(temporary,path)
    status,value=request('POST','/'+index+'/_open')
    if status!=200 or not value.get('acknowledged'):raise RuntimeError('index reopen failed')
```

原题知识说明：
桌面推演，未在生产执行。保存同义词规则与分析链，用官方analyze能力复核失败规则和token图；恢复已验证规则集后按版本支持流程加载。验收多词同义词、停用词及历史查询，不跳过全部坏规则掩盖语义缺口。

 call(server,'PUT','/'+index,{'settings':settings,'mappings':{'properties':{'message':{'type':'text','analyzer':'standard','search_analyzer':'owned_search'}}}})

 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:restore_verified_strict_rules_then_reopen_and_query_historical_synonyms',flush=True)
 original=copy.deepcopy(rules)
 try:task.repair(server.request,index,str(rules_path),rules)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual synonym reopen recovery failed') from error

 assert current['uuid']==uuid and rules_path.read_text().splitlines()==rules and filters['owned_synonyms']['synonyms_path']=='analysis/owned.txt' and filters['owned_synonyms']['lenient']=='false'

title: 真实routing身份合同：同ID跨分片并存，读取更新删除保持同一路由
body:
## 操作任务
实现manage(request,index,routing,docid)。routing非空字符串否则ValueError且零请求；所有路径URL编码并带同一可信routing。GET文档，缺失RuntimeError且不upsert；复制_source，仅quantity加1，PUT带if_seq_no/if_primary_term及refresh=true；GET确认新_source；DELETE带最新并发令牌及refresh=true，必须result=deleted；返回修改后_source。真实required routing下漏传400、错误分片404、同_id两路由两份数据；只删批准路由目标，另一份含_seq_no保持。非成功RuntimeError。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Elasticsearch8.19.7三个主分片，实际_search_shards选择不同物理分片的两个路由并复现同ID并存。验证调用方可信路由一致性与实际删除；不把routing当认证，不宣称热点治理或线上路由迁移完成。

sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from elasticsearch_native import Elasticsearch
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0

def call(server,method,path,body=None):
 status,value=server.request(method,path,body);assert status in (200,201),(method,path,status,value)
 return value
def hits(server,index,body=None):return call(server,'POST','/'+index+'/_search?size=1000&track_total_hits=true',body)['hits']['hits']

 index='routed_docs';call(server,'PUT','/'+index,{'settings':{'number_of_shards':3,'number_of_replicas':0},'mappings':{'_routing':{'required':True},'properties':{'tenant':{'type':'keyword'},'quantity':{'type':'long'}}}})
 def shard(route):return call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_search_shards?routing='+route)['shards'][0][0]['shard']
 target='tenant0';wrong=next('tenant'+str(i) for i in range(1,50) if shard('tenant'+str(i))!=shard(target));docid='same-business-id'
 target_body={'tenant':'a','quantity':4};decoy={'tenant':'b','quantity':90}
 call(server,'PUT','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?routing='+target+'&refresh=true',target_body)
 assert server.request('GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid)[0]==400 and server.request('GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?routing='+wrong)[0]==404
 status,value=server.request('DELETE','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?routing='+wrong+'&refresh=true');assert status==404 and value['result']=='not_found'
 assert call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?routing='+target)['_source']==target_body
 call(server,'PUT','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?routing='+wrong+'&refresh=true',decoy)
 assert len(hits(server,index,{'query':{'ids':{'values':[docid]}}}))==2,'same _id on distinct routed shards did not form two records'
 decoy_before=call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?routing='+wrong)
 print('NATIVE_ELASTICSEARCH_REQUIRED_ROUTING_MISSING400_WRONG404_SAME_ID_TWO_ACTUAL_SHARDS',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:consistent_routed_read_concurrent_update_readback_delete_preserve_other_shard',flush=True)
 calls=[]
 def request(method,path,body=None,**kwargs):calls.append((method,path));return server.request(method,path,body,**kwargs)
 try:result=task.manage(request,index,target,docid)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student actual routed lifecycle failed') from error
 assert result=={'tenant':'a','quantity':5} and server.request('GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?routing='+target)[0]==404
 assert call(server,'GET','/'+index+'/_doc/'+docid+'?routing='+wrong)==decoy_before,'same ID on another shard was changed'
 assert len(hits(server,index))==1 and all('routing='+target in path for method,path in calls)
 for method in ('PUT','DELETE'):assert any(m==method and 'if_seq_no=' in p and 'if_primary_term=' in p for m,p in calls),'concurrency guard missing'
 calls.clear()
 try:task.manage(request,index,'',docid)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('empty routing accepted')
 assert not calls
 try:task.manage(request,index,target,'missing')
 except RuntimeError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('missing routed target auto-created or treated as success')
 assert len(calls)==1 and calls[0][0]=='GET' and len(hits(server,index))==1
